title: X11 Linux child window hang on 4.x.x
body:
### Tested versions

I used the logs to find this exact error and then it hangs itself and i need to use terminal to close it.

`ERROR: Attempting to make child window exclusive, but the parent window already has another exclusive child. This window: /root/@EditorNode@18395/@Panel@14/@ProjectExportDialog@783/@VBoxContainer@146/@AcceptDialog@640, parent window: /root/@EditorNode@18395/@Panel@14/@ProjectExportDialog@783, current exclusive child window: /root/@EditorNode@18395/@Panel@14/@ProjectExportDialog@783/@AcceptDialog@31766`

### System information

Godot v4.6.3.stable - Arch Linux #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Mon, 11 May 2026 07:46:10 +0000 on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6GB (nvidia; 580.159.03) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-7500 CPU @ 3.40GHz (4 threads) - 15.56 GiB memory

### Issue description

I used found this exact error and then it hangs itself.

ERROR: Attempting to make child window exclusive, but the parent window already has another exclusive child. This window: /root/@EditorNode@18395/@Panel@14/@ProjectExportDialog@783/@VBoxContainer@146/@AcceptDialog@640, parent window: /root/@EditorNode@18395/@Panel@14/@ProjectExportDialog@783, current exclusive child window: /root/@EditorNode@18395/@Panel@14/@ProjectExportDialog@783/@AcceptDialog@31766

### Steps to reproduce

All you need to do is open a child window and it has a chance of doing this
